author: Ari Koslow
title: Yosver Zulueta traded to Cubs
desc: The Mariners traded Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs in exchange for cash considerations.
impact: Zulueta was designated for assignment last week by Seattle. He will add pitching depth in the Cubs organization.

author: Nate Miller
title: Cristopher Sanchez not at peak form Sunday
desc: Cristopher Sanchez gave up four runs on eight hits and one walk while striking out three in Sunday's 4-0 loss to the Brewers.
impact: Right up there with Jacob Misiorowski as the two hottest pitchers in the league over the past six weeks or so, Sanchez was knocked around a bit by the Brewers on Sunday. The lefty allowed more than two earned runs for only the second time through 15 starts this season, surrendering two of just six homers he's given up across 99 innings. Even with this loss, Sanchez sports an elite 1.82 ERA and 29.0 K% headed into a matchup with the Mets next weekend.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryce Elder struggles early in Sunday's loss
desc: Bryce Elder allowed six runs on 10 hits and two walks while striking out two over four-plus innings in Sunday's 8-1 loss to the Mets.
impact: Elder was tagged for four runs in the first inning on Sunday. Even though he settled in to hold the Mets scoreless over the next three frames, the righty gave up back-to-back solo homers to begin the bottom of the fifth before being yanked. Elder was coming off a pair of quality outings prior to this loss, and he has now given up more than three earned runs just twice through 15 starts in what has been a very solid season to this point. He will have a tough matchup against the Brewers on Saturday.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Freddy Peralta limits Braves after rough four-start stretch
desc: Peralta has a 3.90 ERA, 1.30 WHIP, and 81:33 K:BB across 83 innings over 15 starts this season and lines up tentatively for a road start against Philadelphia next time out. He had posted a 5.70 ERA across 23.2 innings over his previous four outings before Sunday's turnaround.
impact: Three consecutive singles to open the first inning threatened an early exit, but Peralta held Atlanta to one run in the frame and allowed just one more hit over his final four innings. He finished with two strikeouts across five innings, allowing one run on four hits and a walk to earn the win.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: A.J. Ewing one triple shy of cycle in second three-hit game
desc: Ewing is slashing .267/.339/.381 with seven stolen bases, nine RBI, and 14 runs scored across 120 plate appearances this season and has gone 13-for-38 over his last 11 games. He came one triple shy of the cycle Sunday in just the second three-hit performance of his major-league career.
impact: An RBI double in the first inning put the Mets ahead before Ewing extended the lead to 5-1 with his second homer of the season off Bryce Elder in the fifth. He finished 3-for-5 with a run scored in the 8-1 win over Atlanta.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Nathan Eovaldi wins seventh game of at least seven innings
desc: Eovaldi has a 4.23 ERA, 1.17 WHIP, and 83:21 K:BB across 87.1 innings over 14 starts this season and faces San Diego tentatively on Saturday. He has completed at least seven innings in seven of those 14 starts.
impact: Sunday's outing included two solo homers by Willson Contreras as the only real damage, with Eovaldi finishing with six strikeouts across seven innings for his sixth win of the season.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Jacob Latz has not allowed a run in five June outings
desc: Latz has a 1.62 ERA, 0.60 WHIP, and 35:7 K:BB across 33.1 innings over 26 appearances this season and has yet to allow a run across 7.1 innings in five June outings, converting four saves during that stretch.
impact: He entered Sunday's eighth inning with two outs and a two-run cushion and retired all four batters he faced, finishing with two strikeouts across 1.1 innings for his 11th save of the season.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Kyle Higashioka hits three-run homer over Green Monster
desc: Higashioka is slashing .235/.313/.391 with five home runs, 14 RBI, and 15 runs scored across 128 plate appearances this season and has recorded three multi-hit games over his last 10 appearances. His three-run homer cleared the Green Monster in the second inning Sunday to extend the Rangers' lead before he added a single in the seventh.
impact: Higashioka finished 2-for-4 in the 6-4 win over Boston.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Wyatt Langford homers on first pitch of game in Rangers win
desc: Langford is slashing .241/.285/.397 with three home runs across 29 games this season and has gone 9-for-36 with two homers and four RBI over nine games since returning from the injured list on June 5.
impact: He hit the first pitch of Sunday's game off Connelly Early 418 feet over the left-field wall, giving Texas a lead it never relinquished. Langford finished 1-for-4 with a walk and a run scored in the 6-4 win over Boston.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Brandon Nimmo doubles twice in Rangers' win over Red Sox
desc: Nimmo is slashing .257/.330/.408 with seven home runs, 25 RBI, and 28 runs scored across 69 games in his first season with Texas. He has recorded four multi-hit efforts over his last five starts, including Sunday's two-double performance against Boston.
impact: A two-run double in the fourth inning accounted for both of his RBI before he added another double in the sixth. Nimmo finished 2-for-5 in the 6-4 win over the Red Sox.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Connelly Early sets season worsts in hits and runs allowed
desc: Early has a 3.81 ERA, 1.32 WHIP, and 72:29 K:BB across 75.2 innings over 14 starts this season and faces Seattle tentatively on Saturday. Sunday produced season-worst marks in both hits and runs allowed, with previous highs of six hits and five runs both surpassed.
impact: Wyatt Langford hit a leadoff homer before Kyle Higashioka added a three-run shot in the second inning and Brandon Nimmo delivered a two-run double in the fourth. Early allowed six runs on 11 hits and two walks while striking out three across 4.2 innings in the loss.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Willson Contreras homers twice off Eovaldi in loss
desc: Contreras is slashing .304/.396/.570 with 16 home runs, 43 RBI, and 34 runs scored across 67 games this season. He has slashed .390/.457/.878 with five home runs, five doubles, and 10 RBI across 11 June games.
impact: Both homers Sunday came off Nathan Eovaldi - solo shots in the second and sixth innings. Contreras finished 3-for-4 in the 6-4 loss to Texas.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Yoendrys Gomez fires a clean inning in tight 5-4 win
desc: Yoendrys Gomez struck out one over a perfect inning to earn a save in Sunday's 5-4 win over the Cardinals.
impact: Gomez needed just 10 pitches to do his job and get out before anything interesting happened. After the win, Gomez now has a 4.01 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with an 8.8 K/9 with six saves in six chances. He has emerged as the leader of the Twins' closer committee this season.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Royce Lewis chips in RBI, swipe in 5-4 win
desc: Royce Lewis went 1-for-3 in a 5-4 win over the Cardinals on Sunday with a walk, one RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: After Sunday's win over St. Louis, Lewis is batting .211 with six home runs, 18 RBI, 15 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 39 games. He's been red hot of late, hitting .423 with three homers, five RBI, and a stolen base in his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Taj Bradley bends, Twins don't break in 5-4 win
desc: Taj Bradley allowed four earned runs on five hits and one walk while striking out seven over 6.2 innings in Sunday's 5-4 win over the Cardinals.
impact: Bradley labored but survived the damage. After the outing, he now has a 4.14 ERA and 1.34 WHIP with a 5-3 record through 13 starts. Bradley will look to bounce back in his next start, which will be against the Diamondbacks on Saturday.
